subject: Orphan scanner findings are invisible: STRICT_ORPHAN_MAP.json correctly listed cloud-openstack-project-iac (a finished, QC-harnessed Stage 4 capstone) as unreachable, and it sat there unnoticed. The scanner's STDOUT prints only per-cluster SAMPLES, so grepping the console output for a specific id returns nothing even when the scanner caught it -- I nearly filed a false bug against the scanner because of this. Fix: surface the full per-house orphan list (or a diff vs the previous run) in stdout/Nexus so a new orphan is noticed the day it appears, not weeks later. 420 orphans in a JSON file is data nobody reads.
